title: Bear and Square Grid
statementMd:
You have a grid with $*n*$ rows and $*n*$ columns. Each cell is either empty (denoted by '`.`') or blocked (denoted by '`X`').

Two empty cells are *directly connected* if they share a side. Two cells $(*r*_{1}, *c*_{1})$ (located in the row $*r*_{1}$ and column $*c*_{1}$) and $(*r*_{2}, *c*_{2})$ are *connected* if there exists a sequence of empty cells that starts with $(*r*_{1}, *c*_{1})$, finishes with $(*r*_{2}, *c*_{2})$, and any two consecutive cells in this sequence are directly connected. A *connected component* is a set of empty cells such that any two cells in the component are connected, and there is no cell in this set that is connected to some cell not in this set.

Your friend Limak is a big grizzly bear. He is able to destroy any obstacles in some range. More precisely, you can choose a square of size $*k* × *k*$ in the grid and Limak will transform all blocked cells there to empty ones. However, you can ask Limak to help only once.

The chosen square must be completely inside the grid. It's possible that Limak won't change anything because all cells are empty anyway.

You like big connected components. After Limak helps you, what is the maximum possible size of the biggest connected component in the grid?

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 500$) — the size of the grid and Limak's range, respectively.

Each of the next $*n*$ lines contains a string with $*n*$ characters, denoting the $*i*$-th row of the grid. Each character is '`.`' or '`X`', denoting an empty cell or a blocked one, respectively.

## Output

Print the maximum possible size (the number of cells) of the biggest connected component, after using Limak's help.

## Note

In the first sample, you can choose a square of size $2 × 2$. It's optimal to choose a square in the red frame on the left drawing below. Then, you will get a connected component with $10$ cells, marked blue in the right drawing.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bc3be3998e7988930c7ec84634e6eadca7b7b172.png)
statementZhMd:
有一个 $*n*$ 行 $*n*$ 列的网格。每个单元格要么为空（用 '`.`' 表示），要么被阻塞（用 '`X`' 表示）。

如果两个空单元格共用一条边，则称它们**直接连通**。位于第 $*r*_{1}$ 行、第 $*c*_{1}$ 列的单元格 $(*r*_{1}, *c*_{1})$ 与单元格 $(*r*_{2}, *c*_{2})$ **连通**，当且仅当存在一个由空单元格组成的序列，该序列以 $(*r*_{1}, *c*_{1})$ 开始、以 $(*r*_{2}, *c*_{2})$ 结束，并且序列中任意两个相邻单元格都直接连通。**连通分量**是一个空单元格集合，满足其中任意两个单元格都连通，并且该集合中不存在与集合外某个单元格连通的单元格。

你的朋友 Limak 是一只强壮的大灰熊。他能够摧毁某个范围内的所有障碍物。更准确地说，你可以在网格中选择一个大小为 $*k* × *k*$ 的正方形，Limak 会将其中所有被阻塞的单元格变为空单元格。不过，你只能请求 Limak 帮助一次。

所选择的正方形必须完全位于网格内。也有可能 Limak 什么都不会改变，因为其中的所有单元格本来就是空的。

你喜欢较大的连通分量。在 Limak 帮助你之后，网格中最大的连通分量的大小最大是多少？

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 500$），分别表示网格的大小和 Limak 的作用范围。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含一个长度为 $*n*$ 的字符串，表示网格的第 $*i*$ 行。每个字符都是 '`.`' 或 '`X`'，分别表示空单元格或被阻塞的单元格。

## 输出格式

输出使用 Limak 的帮助后，最大的连通分量的大小（单元格数量）的最大值。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，你可以选择一个大小为 $2 × 2$ 的正方形。选择下方左图中红框所示的正方形是最优的。之后，你将得到一个包含 $10$ 个单元格的连通分量，该分量在右图中以蓝色标出。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bc3be3998e7988930c7ec84634e6eadca7b7b172.png)
